title: DECISION: GroupName validated defence-in-depth at ingress
description: validate_article_ingress() re-validates each Newsgroups entry through GroupName::new() even though GroupName is a validated newtype that should reject invalid names at construction. The comment explicitly explains why: this catches values injected via unchecked constructors, deserialization paths, or future API changes. Defence-in-depth at trust boundaries means a bug in one layer does not silently pass malformed group names into the CRDT log.
